d:
Can India maintain strategic partnerships with the US, close ties with Russia and engagement with China — all at the same time?
In this episode of UPSC Live, Manas Shrivastava decodes India's evolving geopolitical strategy amid the recent Quad Leaders' Meeting, ASEAN-India Summit and East Asia Summit in Manila. From the changing role of the Quad to the proposed Trump-Xi-Putin meeting, he explains the concepts of strategic autonomy, balancing, bargaining and triangulation.
